entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Unbelievable. I can't believe I have to call about this. This is the last time I order from you people!
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Charlie, you can help me by explaining why you sell products that don't even fit! I bought a jersey and it's completely useless to me. I want my money back, now.

I'm very sorry to hear that you're unhappy with your purchase. I can definitely look into this for you. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the material or an issue with the sizing?
It's the wrong size! I ordered a Large, like I always do, and this thing is so tight I can barely breathe in it. This is ridiculous! I want to do an exchange or just get a refund.
Okay, I understand completely. A sizing issue is definitely something we can help with. Do you have your order number handy?

It's VF-8675309. Look, if this is going to be some long, drawn-out process, just get me your manager right now. I'm not playing games. I'll post a review about this experience on every single cycling forum.
I assure you, I can handle this for you. I'm just pulling up your order now... one moment. Okay, I see the Aero-Pro Jersey purchased on October 23rd. Let me just confirm the return eligibility.
There better not be an issue.

No issue at all. You are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you. I am generating a pre-paid return shipping label and sending it to the email address on your account as we speak.
Oh. So... you're just going to take it back? No hassle?
That's correct. Once we receive the jersey, we can issue a full refund to your original payment method or send you the next size up. It's your choice.
Alright. Fine. Just process the refund. So the label is in my email now?

It should arrive within the next 2-3 minutes. Just print it out, place the item back in its original packaging, and drop it off at the post office. Your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days of us receiving the item.
Okay. Well... that's fine then. Thank you.
You are very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good afternoon.
